description: The shared core of the Eclipse social adapter family: one immutable, versioned canonical content object per item (masters + provenance, copy, claims with sources, rights per asset, accessibility assets, disclosure record, intended/prohibited surfaces, schedule) with a SHA-256 content hash; per-adapter native variants with classified adaptation diffs (MEDIA_CROP, TEXT_REWRITE, LINK_PLACEMENT, ORDER, DISCLOSURE, METADATA, FORMAT_OMISSION) where substantive changes — numbers, claims, CTA — are flagged, never silent; hash-bound owner approvals that ANY later change to media, copy, links, order, disclosure, schedule, or destination invalidates; a per-account capability mode registry (PUBLISH_API, DRAFT_API, PREP_PACK, READ_API, OWN_ENGAGEMENT_API, COMMUNITY_PREP, COMMUNITY_API_PILOT) whose effective modes downgrade automatically on a failed capability probe; per-adapter/account/family kill switches; and the engagement policy module — the house engagement playbook as data (week-1 caps 15 likes / 5 comments per day, week-2+ 30/10, 2 likes per target, no links/self-promo/hashtag-stuffing in comments, duplicate-comment refusal, stop-signal finality) exposed as policy_check returning ALLOW/DENY/STOP with a named reason. Governance only: no platform action, no network calls, no credential material. Every ingest, adaptation, approval, revision, policy check (denials included), and kill-switch change appends a hash-chained receipt.
